content.comment_body: Hello, I'm working with several devices ([article_no]) and [product_name] [version_no]. Is there a way to check the current time set on the device without overwriting it? This would help with troubleshooting. Thank you.

Hello, Based on your description, you want to determine the time and date on a [product_name] without a display. This is possible through [product_name] [version_no]. Go to Tools, Transfer, Date & Time, and then select READ. This should display the current time and date set on your device. Alternatively, you could use a [product_name] operator panel to show the date and time. Hope this helps.
Thanks [user_name], I can't believe how many times I've missed that button! Cheers.

analysis.insight_summary: The user needs a way to check the device's current time setting without a display. The suggested solutions — using the 'READ' function in the software or an external operator panel — help verify the time non-intrusively, indicating the interface function isn't immediately obvious.
analysis.user_expectations: The user seeks a straightforward, non-intrusive method to view the current device time through the software interface, rather than overwriting it.
